name: @xiaoyuclaw/dsh-wake-source
description: DSH plugin: let external scripts wake a live agent through a local HTTP endpoint, without an API key.

description.zh: 监听本机 HTTP 端口，把外部事件注入成一条用户消息，从而唤醒已有会话的 agent；没有活着的会话时会新建一个。不需要 API key。
description.en: Listens on a local HTTP port and injects external events as user messages to wake a live agent (or create one). No API key required.
